summary: Discover the power of authentic leadership with our specialized training course. Lead with purpose and make a lasting impact in your organization.
lede: Authentic leadership and purpose training helps professionals responsible for teams connect personal values with organizational goals while guiding change and maintaining performance. Participants practice values-based decision-making, build psychological safety, and use purpose-driven communication to align stakeholders and support hybrid teams. The syllabus also covers emotional self-regulation and resilience for sustainable leadership.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who are responsible for guiding teams through change and maintaining high levels of operational performance.
modules: Foundations of Authentic Leadership and Self-Awareness
Defining Purpose in a Corporate Context
Leading Hybrid and Diverse Teams with Purpose
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in a supervisory or management role. Familiarity with basic organizational behavior concepts is recommended. No specific technical prerequisites are required, though a willingness to engage in self-reflection and peer feedback is essential for success in this program.
